kp-waypoint.name: King's Pass: from the reset group's start, stand on its waypoint (the next place of the reference route at least 7 units away or at another height) within 40 decisions
kp-waypoint.start: a new game of the deterministic build, then the reset group's scripted start prefix (the first k steps of the reference route, 9 frames per step) played through the harness; the episode starts at the first model decision after it

rule.waypoint: the first place after the start where the reference route stands (debug grounded and the harness agrees; route trace on the deterministic build: smoke/route_trace_a/route.json of the collection experiment) whose straight-line distance from the start place is at least 7 units, or whose feet height differs from the start's by at least 0.5 units (the route gets there over a jump or a drop); no waypoint can be reached by one or two plain walking decisions (measured on the 23 clean pilots: at most 3.32 units in one and 5.72 in two plain walking decisions; with the box a flat waypoint is entered only after 6 units)
rule.box: x within 1 and feet height within 0.3 of the waypoint, in King's Pass (Tutorial_01)
rule.win_test: at the end of any bridge window of a model decision the knight stands (debug grounded) with its feet inside the box
rule.loss: the first death (debug: death counter up, health 0 or hero dead)
rule.timeout: 40 model decisions (or 1600 bridge frames after the first decision; the 23 pilots used at most 748 for 40 decisions)
